Thermodynamic Bounds and an Optimal Tempo for Goal-Holding Agents

Three plain truths about what makes a system an agent, why pace matters, and how energy ranks intelligence.

[Finish Right First, Then Rank by Joules]

1/3 An agent must aim at a goal, act on the world, and stay within an energy budget.

2/3 Physics prices every decision, creating one optimal pace between slow idle drain and frantic switching waste.

3/3 Among systems that finish a task correctly, the smarter one is whichever spent less energy.
